# Municipal Ordinance No. 15, Series of 1998

**Abolishing the Position of Human Resource Management Officer II**

## Summary

This ordinance abolishes the position of Human Resource Management Officer II due to the creation of the Human Resource Management Office and the position of Human Resource Management Officer V. It redirects funds appropriated for the abolished position to unappropriated funds of the Municipal Government. Any inconsistent ordinances are repealed, and the ordinance takes effect ten days after approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  Section 1. The position of Human Resource Management Officer II under item No. 02 in the plantilla of personnel under the Municipal Mayor is hereby abolished.
2.  Section 2. Funds appropriated in favor of the position of Human Resource Management Officer II shall be reverted to unappropriated funds of the Municipal Government in the ensuing Supplemental Budget.
3.  Section 3. Any Ordinance or Provision of an Ordinance which is inconsistent with this ordinance is hereby repealed.
4.  Section 4. This Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after approval.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — legislative body of Pitogo, Quezon
- [[Municipal Mayor]] — head of the executive branch of the municipal government
- [[Human Resource Management Office]] — municipal office

## Legal Basis (RA 7160 Sections)

- [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]] (Local Government Code of 1991)

## Timeline

- [[1997]]: Human Resource Management Officer II was promoted to Human Resource Management Officer V upon No. 509 on August 18, [[1997]].
- [[1998]]: Municipal Ordinance No. 15, Series of [[1998]] was enacted.
